title: Orbitarium — Planetary Lab
description: An original responsive planetary-system explorer with a procedural Three.js scene, planet selection and details, orbit/zoom controls, pause and speed controls, reset, and a labelled static fallback when WebGL is unavailable.

exactTestsAndOutcomes.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { build } from 'vite'; const result = await build({ root: process.cwd(), configFile: false, logLevel: 'warn', build: { write: false, outDir: 'dist', rollupOptions: { input: 'index.html' } } }); const outputs = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result]; console.log('Vite bundle check passed (write:false); output bundle(s):', outputs.flatMap(x => x.output || []).map(x => x.fileName).join(', '));"

If WebGL is unavailable, the page displays a labelled static diagram; simulation animation and speed controls are disabled while planet selection and information remain available.
